messages.subject: secr 3.1.3
parts:
A new version of secr is now on CRAN at https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=secr.

See http://www.otago.ac.nz/density/News.html for highlights. The new 'capped' detector type will be explained at length in a future vignette (tentatively secr-detectortypes.pdf).

A few seldom-used functions have new names in 3.1.3 (derived.mash becomes derivedMash, etc.). A bug in sim.capthist foiled attempts to simulate learned responses (since about April, now fixed).

Murray
